scientific_integrity: The finite-support seed is certified by exact rational expectile formulas and exact stop-loss values. A compact-profile stability lemma transfers both strict inequalities to atomless interval-support laws. Numerical experimentation was used only in discovery; the packaged claim depends on algebraic sign certificates and analytic continuity.
scientific_limitations: The result disproves only the implication from the expectile s2 order to the sf order; the converse is not decided. The final atomless examples are obtained by a sufficiently small explicit smoothing family, without a numerical epsilon threshold. Bibliographic searches cannot exclude an independently published counterexample under different terminology.
title: The expectile \(s_2\)-order does not imply the \(sf\)-order
